summary: Thursday's slide was rate-driven: real yields firmed and the 10Y-2Y curve steepened further, squeezing gold and long-duration bonds while equity breadth thinned as defensive shares lagged growth names. Crypto kept its 30-day rally intact but stayed the board's lone bright spot amid falling volume and softening momentum.
tweet: Steeper curve, firmer real yields hit gold and bonds Thursday; breadth thinned in stocks while crypto alone held Greed.
